# M18-S7 unit D: a Go package using logos/arena behaves identically
# under the plain toolchain and the logos toolchain, and with the arena
# experiment on the escape analysis places the region allocation.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

cd m

go run .
stdout '^4 9$'
cp stdout $WORK/gorun.txt

logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/gorun.txt

logos build -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/arenago$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.go:\d+:\d+: .*placed in region'
exists $WORK/arenago$GOEXE

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenago

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

type node struct {
	v int
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	nodes := arena.Make[node](r, 4)
	nodes[2].v = 9
	fmt.Println(len(nodes), nodes[2].v)
}
